findings.finding: Native statement has WHERE plus cosine ORDER BY plus LIMIT k; frozen exact reference removes LIMIT, disables index access, fetches every eligible result and constructs full truth/ties.
findings.inference: A fresh exact-top-k execution endpoint can be investigated without altering truth generation or rebuilding the HNSW graph. Existing exhaustive-reference timers do not measure it.

findings.finding: All six saved480/640 qualification plans are Limit->Index Scan(reviews_hnsw); filters remain executor Filter fields. Plans are estimates, not EXPLAIN ANALYZE.
findings.inference: Existing plans confirm post-filter native mechanism for those fixtures; they do not measure distance-work attribution, exact plan, all600 case plans or actual time.

findings.finding: Origin settings seqscan off, index/indexonly/bitmap on; source effort320, study reference640, iterative off.
findings.inference: Turning seqscan on alone is not proof of an exact route. Candidate must allow seqscan and disable index access on an explicitly owned binding, then verify actual no-ANN plans/output.

findings.finding: Provisioning DDL declares reviews primary key and one full HNSW; saved identities/inspection return selected index, not a full live index catalog.
findings.inference: No scalar total_votes index is declared by this recipe. Absence of later scalar indexes and complete catalog/statistics equality cannot be certified without additional native metadata at a future qualification.

findings.finding: Current and frozen inspection reject partitioned relations and partial/expression HNSW targets; native execution itself supports ordinary SQL without requiring an HNSW result in native mode.
findings.inference: Exact scan is source-feasible through a separately bound experimental reader on unchanged table/index. Partial/partitioned search needs new physical/catalog/backend compatibility scope.

findings.finding: Request-context patch adds threshold feature to observations; it does not implement predicate-subgraph HNSW traversal. Current scan resumes only after candidates are exhausted.
findings.inference: Neither threshold features nor iterative mode are ACORN. All current outputs have10; iterative changes are not a demonstrated quality repair or selected next mechanism.

findings.finding: ACORN-1 uses search-time neighbor expansion but its documented construction is an unpruned HNSW variant. Local pgvector SelectNeighbors applies a diversity/pruning heuristic.
findings.inference: Do not claim all ACORN variants necessarily require dense rebuilds, or that current pruned graph is ACORN-1 compatible. Any query-only adaptation would be a new native intervention needing its own proof/module identity.

findings.finding: Only three exposed pre-query predicate contexts; raw vector present but no qualified within-context predictor. Broker count evaluates offline snapshot metadata.
findings.inference: Use validated predicate AST/k only for any later simple route; no query/group IDs, evaluator names, free exact selectivity, truth/timing/plan-outcome leakage or new feature learning now.
